# Monitor of monitor 覆蓋

150 條 alert，涵蓋 32／34 個訊號。

## 缺少的訊號

| 優先度 | 層 | 訊號 | 為什麼需要 |
|---|---|---|---|
| high | L1 | 資料新鮮度 heartbeat | vector(1) 不依賴資料；scrape 或 TSDB 壞掉時它依然正常 |
| high | K8s | OOMKilled／重啟原因 | Prometheus 自己看不到被殺的原因 |

## 已涵蓋（請再確認門檻與路由）

| 層 | 訊號 | Alert |
|---|---|---|
| L0 | 外部 dead man's switch | Watchdog |
| L1 | 關鍵 target 消失或停機 | AlertmanagerClusterDown, AlertmanagerClusterCrashlooping, TargetDown, KubeAPIDown, KubeletDown |
| L1 | Prometheus 自身停機（外部） | AlertmanagerClusterDown, AlertmanagerClusterCrashlooping |
| L2 | for 計時反覆重置 | AlertForTimerResetting |
| L3 | Scrape 耗時接近 interval | ScrapeSlowerThanInterval |
| L3 | 實際 scrape 間隔拉長 | ScrapeIntervalStretched |
| L3 | Scrape 超過 sample／body 上限 | PrometheusDuplicateTimestamps, PrometheusOutOfOrderTimestamps, PrometheusScrapeBodySizeLimitHit, PrometheusScrapeSampleLimitHit |
| L3 | Rule group 跳過 evaluation | PrometheusMissingRuleEvaluations, RuleGroupMissingEvaluations |
| L3 | Rule group 耗時比值 | RuleGroupNearInterval |
| L3 | Rule 評估失敗 | PrometheusRuleFailures, RuleEvaluationFailures |
| L3 | Rule group 停止評估 | RuleGroupStale |
| L3 | 查詢排隊 | PrometheusHighQueryLoad, QueryQueueing |
| L3 | 通知送出失敗 | PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToSomeAlertmanagers, PrometheusErrorSendingAlertsToAnyAlertmanager, NotificationsFailing |
| L3 | 通知被丟棄 | NotificationsDropped |
| L3 | Notifier queue 接近滿 | PrometheusNotificationQueueRunningFull |
| L3 | 沒有可用的 Alertmanager | PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers, NoAlertmanagerDiscovered |
| L3 | Alertmanager 通知失敗 | AlertmanagerFailedToSendAlerts, AlertmanagerClusterFailedToSendAlerts, AlertmanagerClusterFailedToSendAlerts, AlertmanagerNotificationsFailing |
| L3 | Alertmanager 設定載入失敗 | AlertmanagerFailedReload, AlertmanagerConfigReloadFailed |
| L3 | Alertmanager 叢集異常 | AlertmanagerMembersInconsistent |
| L3 | 設定檔載入失敗 | PrometheusBadConfig |
| L3 | 重啟 | AlertmanagerClusterCrashlooping, PrometheusRestarted |
| L3 | WAL 寫入失敗 | WALWriteFailed |
| L3 | Checkpoint 失敗 | WALCheckpointFailing |
| L3 | WAL 啟動修復 | WALRepairedAtStartup |
| L3 | WAL fsync 變慢 | WALFsyncSlow |
| L3 | Compaction 失敗 | PrometheusTSDBCompactionsFailing, CompactionFailing |
| L3 | Reload 停止或失敗 | PrometheusTSDBReloadsFailing, BlockReloadStalled |
| L3 | Head 未落成 block | HeadNotCompacting |
| L3 | Retention 落後 | RetentionBehind |
| L3 | 磁碟或 PVC 空間 | KubePersistentVolumeFillingUp, KubePersistentVolumeFillingUp, NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp, NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp, NodeFilesystemAlmostOutOfSpace |
| K8s | CPU throttling | CPUThrottlingHigh, PrometheusCPUThrottled |
| K8s | 記憶體接近 limit | PrometheusMemoryNearLimit |
